why: The aluminas again with Al's nonlinear core correction: without it stripping Al to Al³⁺ was 0.6 eV off all-electron (now 5 meV), and the first plane-wave ranking put θ and the impostor ~1.5 eV per formula above corundum where PBE says 0.5 and 0.15. Each structure and scale on its own runner, four k-point workers, ecut 40.
